entities.summary: Bohuslav Fuchs was a Czech modernist architect. He also worked as a university teacher and urban planner. He is considered one of the most important Czech architects of the 20th century. His work is primarily associated with the city of Brno. Bohuslav Fuchs was a writers & intellectuals from Všechovice (1895-03-24, Všechovice–1972-09-18). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
